name: DEATHBOUND_GENERATION_MANIFEST
purpose: Machine-readable record of every visual generation attempt in the Deathbound temporal continuity pipeline. Extends the existing Deathbound production architecture; it does not replace any existing schema.

field_rules.shot_id: Must exist in the episode production shot list.
field_rules.input_visual_state: Full provider-neutral visual state object from the Visual State Manager for this shot.
field_rules.previous_shot: Null only for shots whose continuity.inherits_previous_shot_state is false; otherwise the previous_shot_id from the shot specification.
field_rules.previous_final_frame: Artifact reference to the previous connected shot's extracted final frame; null only when previous_shot is null. Simulated artifacts must carry simulated: true.
field_rules.character_references: Reference-bank selections for every character in the shot, each carrying reference_id, kind, source and simulated flag.
field_rules.prompt: Deterministic prompt assembled from the visual state and canonical identity; no provider-specific syntax.
field_rules.provider: Provider identifier registered through the VideoGeneratorAdapter; never hard-coded.
field_rules.model: Model identifier as reported by the selected provider; null when a provider has no model concept.
field_rules.generation_parameters: Provider-facing parameters actually sent (or simulated), including duration, fps, resolution and conditioning flags.
field_rules.output_artifact: Generated clip artifact reference. simulated: true for dry-run placeholders; never claimed as real media.
field_rules.final_frame_artifact: Extracted last frame artifact registered as the next shot's continuity state; simulated: true in dry-run.
field_rules.validation_result: Structured QA result: valid flag, checks list with check name/status/detail.
field_rules.retry_count: Number of regeneration attempts performed after the initial attempt (0 = first attempt succeeded).
field_rules.errors: List of accumulated provider/validation errors across attempts; empty when the attempt chain succeeded.

artifact_reference.simulated_semantics: simulated=true means the artifact is a deterministic dry-run placeholder (JSON stub or locally synthesized test media) and must never be presented as real generated video.
